decision.owner: Repository owner Yes on the narrow contract-evolution policy amendment, 2026-10-15; applied here by the coordinator after independent review
decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-avisfu for implementation bead bu-kqyd6c (PR #4738, the Gemini adapter stops passing --system-prompt, which Gemini CLI does not define and whose strict parser rejects, and delivers the system prompt through the documented GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD file override). Reviewed before: main 7cbcbfa13faa1fbe593d6a0fbb57555adeeed888 as recorded in bu-llip14; approved subject: PR #4738 head bdf3189a92ff09aabe3cec27b233c1e1e861f585 plus the reviewer-computed request. Governing requirement REQ-core-spawner-012 (Multi-Runtime Adapter Support) in openspec/specs/core-spawner/spec.md, whose ID-only header lands in this same change in the canonical spec and the active generalist-lead-focused-delegation delta; the PR amends the Gemini scenario inside the block. The one owner, tests/adapters/test_gemini_adapter.py::test_invoke, inverts its assertion to pin the absence of the undefined flag. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

owners.reason: The retained assertion pinned `--system-prompt` on the Gemini argv. Gemini CLI defines no such option, and its yargs parser is `.strict()` (packages/cli/src/config/config.ts at v0.64.0), so every invocation with a system prompt exited 1. The assertion is inverted to pin the flag's absence. The prompt now reaches the CLI through the documented GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD file override, as the amended Gemini scenario of REQ-core-spawner-012 states.
